tables.name: entries
tables.label: Entries
tables.description: The universal node — a project, task, comment, note, or embedded tool (wireframe / sheet / doc / sketch). Every entry has a title and a comment; its type decides its content. Nodes DON'T store a parent — they relate to each other through the `relations` table, so one node can live under many parents.

tables.name: relations
tables.label: Relations
tables.description: The edges of the graph. Each row links two entries: {fromId, toId, type}. type `contains` is structural parent→child (builds the tree); references / depends_on / relates_to / blocks (and custom) are free cross-links. A node can be linked under many parents (many-to-many).

tables.name: users
tables.label: People
tables.description: The people on this board. Defined here, addable any time; an entry's 'created by' and 'prompting' chips point at them.

tables.name: tag_types
tables.label: Tag types
tables.description: The tag vocabulary for this board — add, rename, or recolor a tag type here and it's live everywhere an entry can be tagged (the record editor, Add-filter). Defined here, addable any time.

tables.name: dash_headline
tables.label: Dash headline
tables.description: One row (id "now"): the fleet right now — waiting/running/blocked/done counts, agents live, today's output/cache tokens, and the current usage-window clock (start, reset, minutes left, output this window, busiest window in 30 days). Fetched on Refresh (mode: replace).

provenance.source: fleet-snapshot.sh on the Mac → https://167.233.64.97/fleet/aidev.json (Refresh action)

tables.name: dash_sessions
tables.label: Dash sessions
tables.description: One row per fleet session: title, session tag, lane (awaiting-user/running/blocked/done), timing, activity, applets touched, heaviest model and its output/cache tokens, agent counts. Powers the Now tab's lanes and the Applets tab's per-applet session list.

tables.name: dash_by_model
tables.label: Dash tokens by model
tables.description: Output tokens, cache reads and turns per model per range (today/7d/30d) — Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, other. Powers the Tokens tab's bar charts.

tables.name: dash_by_day
tables.label: Dash tokens by day
tables.description: Output tokens, cache reads and session count per day for the last 14 days. Powers the Tokens tab's daily chart.

tables.name: dash_by_applet
tables.label: Dash tokens by applet
tables.description: Output tokens and session count per applet per range (today/7d/30d) — kind marks whether the row is a real applet, shared engine work, or fleet infra. Powers the Applets tab.

tables.name: dash_timeline
tables.label: Dash timeline
tables.description: One row per 15-minute activity bin per session — session, title, applet, start/end, output tokens, day and range (today/yesterday/7d). Powers the Timeline tab's gantt.
